hero.subtitle: A private luxury bamboo villa in the quiet hills of East Bali – built from the earth, made for slow days.

about.title: Rooted in nature, crafted from bamboo
paragraphs: "Mula" means origin – the root of things. Mula Bali is a single luxury villa in Selat, Karangasem, where bamboo architecture, terracotta tones and mountain air come together in one quiet retreat.
[Tambahkan cerita singkat tentang villa: pemandangan, fasilitas utama, pengalaman tamu.]
